question_text: Probably just junk at this point, but you never know.
agent_response:
That "you never know" is exactly why they stay closed! It’s the fear of throwing away a potential treasure (or a sentimental item) that keeps the boxes sealed.

Since you’re already in the garage, maybe try the **"Box of Shame"** method? Grab one box, open it, and if you don’t immediately recognize the item or remember why it’s important, it goes straight into a "Donate/Trash" bag. If you hesitate, put it back in the box. By the end of the session, if that box is still full, you can seal it up, label it "Maybe Later," and put it in a high, hard-to-reach spot. Usually, if you haven’t needed it in six months, you won’t need it in six more.

It’s a great way to clear the visual clutter without getting bogged down in every single detail. Plus, clearing out the junk makes room for that slow cooker chili prep space! 📦✨
